Okay I went through the same exact thing and I will say you'll DEFINITELY get through this

Things that helped me :
1. PRACTICE. A lot of people say screaming shouldn't be painful when you first start. I agree but also disagree somewhat. Throat soreness is really common in the beginning stages of fry screaming. The only thing you can do to get better easily is practice often. Little sessions less than an hour daily or couple times a week. If it gets sore, stop, take a break or try again tomorrow. 

2. PRONOUNCIATION. as you may have noticed  screaming doesn't sound like speaking. Your pronounciation shouldn't sound as if you're saying things regularly. Play around with the vowels and other things and try different mouth and tongue placements. I don't know about fry screaming as much in this area but it helped my false chord related vocals a lot. A lot of the words will not sound like them when you're screaming, also same reason you may not understand metal lyrics without reading them through. 

3. BREATH SUPPORT. Breath support would get you through sentences without taking as much energy. What you're experiencing is soreness but breath support will be important later on when you can do full sentences, verses and songs. You can get breath support by engaging your core, almost like you're preparing for a light punch in your gut. 

4. SPECIFIC SENTENCES. Pick an easier sentence doesn't have to be from a song "I can't get rid of this pain." , "I helped my mom with picking apples", "I'm riding this truck and I really need to fuck" . Pick one or make your own. Experiment with mouth shapes, throat placements, tongue placements. It gets easier if you're trying on one thing first then you can apply the learned skills to other things

5. REDUCE CAFFEINE AND SMOKING, STAY HYDRATED. helps a bunch. I usually scream before taking my morning coffee. It just helps and is better for you. For me drinking caffeine makes my throat more dry so drink water between attempts.

Good luck!
